title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in IdeaBox Creations PowerPack Lite for Beaver… (CVE-2026-110897)
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in IdeaBox Creations PowerPack Lite for Beaver Builder, affecting versions up to and including 1.3.1. This vulnerability allows an attacker to inject malicious scripts that could be executed in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.1. No specific patch or remediation information is provided in the available data.
aiSummary: The vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-110897 is a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) flaw in the PowerPack Lite for Beaver Builder plugin by IdeaBox Creations. It results from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing malicious scripts to be stored and executed when other users view the affected content. The affected versions include all versions up to 1.3.1. The CVSS 3.1 base score is 7.1, indicating a high severity with network attack vector, low attack complexity, no privileges required, user interaction required, scope changed, and impacts on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
aiImpact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in the context of the affected web application, potentially leading to data theft, session hijacking, or other malicious actions impacting confidentiality, integrity, and availability. The vulnerability requires user interaction and can be exploited remotely without privileges.
